asked: Given a student selects a teacher and a free slot, when they complete the booking, then a 60-minute class is reserved in the system.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer books a free time on the public page without an account: provides name, email and phone, the booking is created and a confirmation email with a cancel link is sent
planCriteria.criterion: A customer books a free time on the public page without an account and the booking is created
Given a successful booking, when the transaction completes, then a confirmation email is sent to the student containing a unique cancellation link.

asked: Given a student clicks the cancellation link, when the current time is more than 12 hours before the class, then the booking is successfully cancelled.
Given a student clicks the cancellation link, when the current time is less than 12 hours before the class, then the cancellation is denied.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email more than the notice hours before the start time; inside the notice period the link is refused
planCriteria.criterion: A customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email before the notice hours; inside the notice period the link is refused

asked: Given a teacher logs in, when they view their dashboard, then they see a calendar displaying their scheduled classes for the week.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a staff member signs in and sees the bookings in the day and week calendar per team member (stylist, therapist…)
planCriteria.criterion: A staff member signs in and sees the bookings in the day and week calendar per team member
Given a teacher accesses their calendar, when they select specific dates, then they can mark those dates as holidays to prevent bookings.
